question: How should the kuṇḍalī power be visualized in the nectar-stream triangle?
premises: The site of visualization is the triangle of the nectar stream.
The object is the previously mentioned kuṇḍalī power.
She is to be contemplated as divinely beautiful.
inference: Therefore one should visualize her in the nectar-stream triangle as a divinely beautiful goddess.
plain_english: In the triangle of the nectar stream, one should visualize her as a divinely beautiful goddess.
